verdict.rationale: Firebase docs state that Cloud Functions can run backend code triggered by Cloud Scheduler jobs, so recurring scheduled jobs are possible, and functions deploy with a single CLI command. The support is a single brief mention, though, and it relies on Google Cloud Scheduler rather than a documented Firebase-native scheduling feature. An older community comment says scheduled tasks were missing at the time; that predates the current docs and is not a concrete counter-example. Missing for 10: detailed docs on scheduled/cron function syntax and limits, multi-step workflow orchestration, AI-agent or MCP control of schedules, and independent hands-on corroboration.
